original_record.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

Subject: Authentic classic Mega Man Cut Man. Small childlike robot proportions, pale humanlike face with large eyes, white helmet topped by enormous red-and-silver scissors, red torso and forearms/boots, white limbs and dark waist. One original compact industrial vibro mace held low is his single arena melee allocation; the fixed head scissors identify source. Preserve source colours and big simple shapes, no bulked-up adult soldier.
Metadata only, do not render text: #159 slot 1 Cut Man.
original_record.visual_review: Accepted — reviewed for source identity, complete-body framing, readable silhouette, materials and arena equipment

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Mega Man  
**Strategy:** Squadron · **Target roster:** 6 robots  
**Opening:** 3 robots · **Hard cap:** 6 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `wily-robot-master-foundry`

**Proposed robots:** Cut Man; Guts Man; Bomb Man; Ice Man; Fire Man; Elec Man.

**Source edition:** The six original Robot Masters from Mega Man (1987), using their classic character designs. The Powered Up manual is an identity reference; do not adopt its extra Oil Man and Time Man slots.

**Naming:** All six names identify separate source characters. This six-member Squadron replaces the earlier open-ended eleven-slot Swarm proposal.

**Backstory:** Wily requisitions six specialists with very different day jobs and equally difficult personalities. The first industrial trio secures the arena; ice, fire, and electricity complete the roster.

**Purchasing personality:** Ice Man joins Bomb Man to complete the second pair. Fire Man and Elec Man complete the elemental trio and final pair. Buy six distinct characters, with no numbered filler units.

**Robot blueprints**

| Slot | Arena robot name | Source identity | Joins | Arena role | Loadout | Stance / yield | Build_Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Cut Man** | Cut Man | Opening | Close cutter | `single` | offensive / 10% | Sprinter |
| 2 | **Guts Man** | Guts Man | Opening | Protected heavy anchor | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 20% | Warden |
| 3 | **Bomb Man** | Bomb Man | Opening | Mid-range firepower | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Bruiser |
| 4 | **Ice Man** | Ice Man | Growth #1 | Ranged covering fire | `single` | balanced / 20% | Tactician |
| 5 | **Fire Man** | Fire Man | Growth #2 | Close pressure | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Bruiser |
| 6 | **Elec Man** | Elec Man | Growth #3 | Mid-range line shooter | `single` | balanced / 15% | Versatile |

**Weapon paths** — stage 0 on recruitment, then stage 1. Prices are combined list-price equipment subtotals, not total robot or stable purchase costs.

| Slot | Range from weapons | Stage 0 | Stage 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | melee | Practice Sword (₡50,000) | Vibro Mace (₡425,000) |
| 2 | short | Laser Pistol + Light Shield (₡108,000) | Volt Sabre + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |
| 3 | mid | Training Rifle (₡50,000) | Plasma Cannon (₡408,000) |
| 4 | long | Beam Pistol (₡93,000) | Particle Lance (₡425,000) |
| 5 | short | Scatter Cannon (₡84,000) | Arc Projector (₡488,000) |
| 6 | mid | Bolt Carbine (₡93,000) | Nova Caster (₡425,000) |

**Equipment planning totals:** opening trio ₡208,000; recruits 4–6 at stage 0 ₡270,000; all six at stage 1 ₡3,005,000; 7 equipped weapon/shield items at the six-robot target. The stage-0 equipment component of the slot-5-and-6 recruitment reserve is ₡177,000, plus both robot frames, required facilities, and maintenance reserve.

**Refinement plans — after all six robots reach stage 1**

Execute each row from left to right. Costs and workshop gates for every operation are in the [shared refinement rules](#squadron-refinement-rules). Main/offhand targets are explicit; all six robots have a non-empty plan.

| Slot | Robot | Ordered refinement steps | Refinement subtotal |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | **Cut Man** | Main Vibro Mace: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Vibro Mace: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 2 | **Guts Man** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |
| 3 | **Bomb Man** | Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Combat Power 7→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Critical Systems 6→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Augment Hull Integrity +3 (new) → Main Plasma Cannon: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Plasma Cannon: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,130,000 |
| 4 | **Ice Man** | Main Particle Lance: Hone Targeting Systems 8→10 → Main Particle Lance: Augment Weapon Control +3 (new) → Main Particle Lance: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Particle Lance: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 5 | **Fire Man** | Main Arc Projector: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Arc Projector: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 6 | **Elec Man** | Main Nova Caster: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Nova Caster: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |

**Refinement budget:** ₡5,320,000 across six robots. Final stage-1 equipment plus refinement totals ₡8,325,000; stage-0 purchases and facility, frame, training, and maintenance costs are additional.

**Portrait blueprints** — show one complete body using the shared art direction. Signature features identify the source; every active weapon or shield must map to the equipment allocations above.

| Slot | Portrait and equipment brief |
|---|---|
| 1 | Classic Cut Man head cutter, small body, and source proportions. One melee arena weapon; the signature cutter is its visual identity, not a second attack. |
| 2 | Classic Guts Man broad jaw, large arms, and sturdy body. One short-range weapon plus an original arena shield; no automatic lifting or terrain-destruction mechanic. |
| 3 | Classic Bomb Man round body and distinctive head crest. One heavy mid-range arena weapon with explosive styling; no invented grenade inventory or area-damage rule. |
| 4 | Classic Ice Man parka-like robot design and recognizable face. One long-range arena weapon; cold imagery does not grant a freeze status effect. |
| 5 | Classic Fire Man head flame housing and source arm shapes. One heavy short-range arena emitter; retain the source silhouette without an extra independent flame attack. |
| 6 | Classic Elec Man mask, lightning motif, and source body proportions. One mid-range arena weapon; electrical styling adds no stun or chain-damage mechanic. |

**Named teams and fixed membership** — all names are original Armoured Souls team labels.

| Format | Team name | Fixed members | Forms |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2v2 | **Cut and Carry** | 1 Cut Man + 2 Guts Man | Opening trio |
| 2v2 | **Cold Detonation** | 3 Bomb Man + 4 Ice Man | When slot 4 joins |
| 2v2 | **Live Wires** | 5 Fire Man + 6 Elec Man | When slot 6 joins |
| 3v3 | **Wily Work Crew** | 1 Cut Man + 2 Guts Man + 3 Bomb Man | Opening trio |
| 3v3 | **Elemental Overload** | 4 Ice Man + 5 Fire Man + 6 Elec Man | When slot 6 joins |

**Shared parameters:** apply the Squadron recruitment, fixed-team, event-order, budget, tuning, refinement, and image rules below. Slots 1–3 open together; buy 4, then 5, then 6. No reserve slots or substitution alternatives are included.

References: [Capcom Robot Master identity reference](https://static.capcom.com/megaman/manuals/PSP_MMPU_Manual.pdf), [Capcom Legacy Collection character-art reference](https://news.capcomusa.com/tag/playstation/page/102).
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3. Recruit slot 4, then fund the complete slot-5/slot-6 pair before buying 5 followed by 6. Finish all six final loadouts before refinement. Invest in slot order 1,4,2,5,3,6, with Hone, Augment, first Sharpen and first Forge passes through Workshop L1, L3, L5 and L8. Keep funding and prestige-gated steps pending.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, upkeep, repair costs, discounts and resale. Alternatives excluded.
